name: William Rex
original_name: ウィリアム・レックス
source:
The No. 1 member of the Crown, an imperial command unit under the direct order of the Queen. He is feared as a symbol of diabolical evil.

He is a libertine who acts freely with the goal of "being his own master."

He tempts you into a world filled with sweet sin, but...

Organisation: Crown
Fairy Tale Curse: Alice in Wonderland's Queen of Hearts

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/villains/original/character/#william]official website[/url]]
